hero.title: Oil Spill Monitoring
hero.text: Geomatic provides a proactive monitoring service for oil spills, whether natural seeps or man-made spills such as illegal discharge from vessels and leakage from offshore oil infrastructure, which are major contributors to environmental pollution and its impact.

brochure.title: Oil spill monitoring solution
brochure.text: Remote sensing monitoring service for offshore areas, with daily or weekly reporting during normal periods, especially for spill identification at sea.

items.title: Oil spill analysis
points: Oil spill analysis applying machine learning algorithms
